definition: A reusable type or function that can work with multiple types using placeholders like <T>.
A placeholder type like T or E used in a generic type/function (e.g., Result<T, E>).
A discriminated union that represents success (ok + value) or failure (ok=false + error) explicitly.
When TypeScript automatically figures out types from how you use values and functions.
A TypeScript type meaning 'no possible value'. Often used in Result helpers to express impossible branches.
